parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format in UTC.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: The performance metrics. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,). For more information, see [Performance parameters](~~141787~~).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format in UTC.
